name: radiology-reporting-suite
description: Local-first radiology reporting workflow: guided New Case -> Dictation -> Processing -> Review -> Export flow with a cases dashboard, browser-native voice dictation, and text-based PDF export. RadioReport v2 design. No backend, no AI model calls, no network calls.
notes: No build step. jsPDF is vendored locally in lib/ and webfonts are self-hosted in assets/fonts/ (no CDN dependency at runtime).
Run `npm start` (or any static file server) and open http://localhost:8080.
Data persists in browser localStorage only - nothing leaves the machine.
The Processing / AI-parse step is a visual transition only; there is no backend or model call.
